family: Titan mini condenser and illumination system
title: Titan Training Material
owner: FEI; public university host Oregon State University
date_note: The formal publication date was not confirmed from the original in this round; 2025-09 in the URL is only a hosting directory.
supported_facts: The manufacturer's teaching diagram shows optical relationships among C1/C2/C3, the mini condenser, and the upper objective.
Optically switching the mini condenser involves opposite current directions and must not be interpreted as coil current always being zero.
unsupported_claims: An optical diagram is not a manufacturing section and cannot be used to measure internal geometry by proportion.
The local PDF is an image scan without a text layer.
